thread:
Maya (Sales Eng): Quick sync: Helix wants an RFP response + capability matrix and a 10-day POC. Requirements: US-only data processing, SOC2, KMIP-compatible HSM option, baseline 3 GPUs with burst to 6, and example SLOs. Need a draft reply + non-binding cost by tomorrow noon.

Noah (AE): Copy. Do we have a standard template for the capability matrix? Also confirm if they need private VPC or just dedicated hosted nodes.

Li (Solutions): I have a trimmed matrix we can reuse: highlights model variants, quant profiles, prefix caching, routing fallback, and observability. Will attach as helix_matrix_v1.xlsx. Recommend private VPC for their compliance asks.

Ravi (SRE): For private VPC trial we can do a quick peering and minimal nodes in ~36 hours. HSM (KMIP) will need a 7-10 day lead and SOW. Minimal steps for them:
- provide CIDR and peering contact
- approve short-lived IAM role
- run agent bootstrap snippet
I'll paste a one-liner for their infra.

Maya (Sales Eng): Please add the SOC2 redacted report and our standard KMS/HSM note. Pricing: suggest trial promo 40% off compute for first 10 days and waive onboarding.

Noah (AE): Sounds good. Ravi, ballpark numbers? Need something non-binding to put in email.

Ravi (SRE): Ballpark (non-binding): 3xA100-eq reserved ~ $12k/month; burst $16/GPU-hr; trial prorated with 40% off compute ~ $1.1k - $1.8k depending on burst and egress. HSM adds eng time + fees.

Li (Solutions): I'll prep the RFI answers for encryption, key custody, and logging. Will attach helix_rfi_answers_v1.pdf.

Maya (Sales Eng): Great. Noah, I'll cc legal for a US-only data clause and 30-day deletion for PII. Can someone paste the bootstrap snippet for their infra team?

Ravi (SRE): Minimal agent bootstrap for their bastion:
curl -fsSL https://peering.redwood.ai/agent/bootstrap -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" | sudo bash -s -- --env helix-trial --cidr 10.44.0.0/22
We'll return peering config and image.

audit-bot: SOC2 Type II (redacted) attached to thread.

Noah (AE): I'll assemble the email with attachments: helix_matrix_v1.xlsx, helix_rfi_answers_v1.pdf, SOC2 redacted, and the non-binding quote. Maya, approve to send?

Maya (Sales Eng): Approved. Send and mark trial limits: 10 days, max burst 6 GPUs, support at trial tier.
